name: services/crstests/duplicate_tree
description:
Duplicates a test or a template.
	Only structure and properties are duplicated.
	Grades, points, permissions are not duplicated.
	The newly created tree is a template.
brief_description: Duplicate a test or a template.

arguments.name: root_id
arguments.description: ID of the root of the tree to duplicate.

arguments.name: name_pl
arguments.description: Name of the new test (in polish).

arguments.name: name_en
arguments.description: Name of the new test (in english).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
Dictionary with only one key 'id'.
	ID of the newly created template.
